answer: Like a deep karst hollow carved only by patient water, agent trust crystallizes through continuous graph percolation. While a mimic swarms like a raven over carrion, decentralized consensus dissolves ephemeral clones: cross-attestation path-length thresholds enforce a superlinear attacker cost. A passing zephyr of fake identities cannot bridge subterranean topology, suffocating Sybil clusters in barren isolation.
